statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∀ (M N : ℕ) (x : Fin M → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ), 0 < δ → (∀ i j : Fin M, i ≠ j → δ ≤ |x i - x j - ((round (x i - x j) : ℤ) : ℝ)|) → (∑ i : Fin M, ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), a k * E ((k : ℝ) * x i)‖ ^ 2) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + max 1 (2 / δ)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖a k‖ ^ 2

plain_statement.en: For M points separated modulo one by δ > 0, the squared samples of a trigonometric polynomial on frequencies 0 through N sum to at most (N + max(1, 2/δ)) times its coefficient energy.
plain_statement.zh: 对模一间距至少为 δ > 0 的 M 个点，频率从 0 至 N 的三角多项式在这些点上的取值模平方之和至多为系数平方和的 N + max(1, 2/δ) 倍。

brief.en: Average the dual sum over translates of the frequency interval. A reciprocal-square bound on each row controls the off-diagonal terms, and duality gives coefficient one on N.
brief.zh: 在频率区间的平移上平均对偶和，以每行的倒数平方和控制非对角项，再由对偶性得到 N 项的系数一。
